descriptionChirho: To desire or covet something, ranging from sinful coveting (Decalogue) to neutral or positive longing, used in Qal active forms across all persons and tenses.
A desired or treasured object, used as a Qal passive participle functioning as a substantive noun referring to something valued or coveted.
Having the quality of being desirable or worthy of desire, used as a Nifal participle with adjectival force describing something pleasant, precious, or attractive.
To take intense delight or pleasure in something, expressed through the Piel intensive stem conveying heightened or focused desire.
